note: Inlined dynamic-import namespaces in extension/background/index.js whose declaration lands AFTER their first read. All current entries are LATENT: every read sits inside a function, so they only bite if bundle evaluation aborts partway and leaves later consts uninitialised while already-registered listeners stay live. That is how login died with "Cannot access 'midnightSync_service' before initialization". This list may only shrink; a new entry fails the build. NOTE: midnightWalletStatePersistence was NOT an offender before the midnight-sync static-import fix - converting one dynamic import to static reorders the bundle and can push another module into the hazard. Evidence that per-module static imports relocate this rather than eliminate it; the complete fix is converting every same-chunk dynamic import in this bundle, since format:'iife' means none of them can code-split.
